intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Two officials are arguing over a single sheet of paper. One of them is doing vocal exercises.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I inspected a gate. It opens. It closes. It passed.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “They are deciding whose voice sounds most heroic announcing it.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The second official tries it with a long pause before *closes*. He has requested trumpets.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “The hinge-oiler. He did most of it. Nobody has asked his name.”

options.labelText: “Just read it out the way you said it to me. ‘It opens. It closes. It passed.’”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She takes the sheet and reads it out in one breath, then adds: *“Hinges by Tobble.”*

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: One official looks physically pained by the absence of trumpets.

options.labelText: “Let them have their trumpets. It’s a big moment for a gate.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “It is a medium moment for a gate.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The heroic announcement goes ahead, with trumpets. The hinge-oiler is not in it.
